aboutPage.heroDescription: For over 15 years, we have been creating exceptional journeys for luxury and authenticity enthusiasts
aboutPage.missionP1: At Afalou Tours, we believe each journey is an opportunity to create unforgettable memories. Our mission is to transform your travel dreams into exceptional real experiences.
aboutPage.missionP2: We meticulously select the most prestigious destinations, hotels, and experiences to offer you impeccable service and exceptional moments.
aboutPage.missionP3: Our team of experts, passionate about travel and service, is dedicated to creating tailor-made itineraries that meet your highest expectations.
aboutPage.engagementsSubtitle: Every recommendation, every organized trip reflects our core values.
aboutPage.value1Desc: Our system analyzes your preferences to suggest the Algerian destinations that suit you best, whether natural, cultural, or seaside sites.
aboutPage.value2Desc: From flight bookings to visa processing, including VIP transfers and accommodation, we handle every detail of your journey.
aboutPage.value3Desc: Based in Béjaïa, we intimately know the Algerian terrain — from Tikjda to Biskra, from Lac L'antenne to Hammam Debagh in Guelma — to offer you authentic excursions.
aboutPage.contactSubtitle: Our team is available from Sunday to Thursday to answer all your questions.
aboutPage.ctaDescription: Let our system recommend the ideal destination according to your desires, or contact us directly to organize your next trip.

aboutSection.title: Afalou Tours,
aboutSection.description: For over 15 years, {{name}} has been helping you discover the riches of Algeria and organizing your trips to the most beautiful destinations — with passion, professionalism, and a 100% Algerian warm welcome.
aboutSection.paragraph1: Located in the heart of the Edimco district in Béjaïa, our agency supports each traveler with care and expertise. Whether you want to explore the Kherrata gorges, venture into the immensity of the Sahara, dive into the crystalline waters of the Béjaïa coast, or discover the Roman ruins of Timgad — we design your tailor-made trip.
aboutSection.paragraph2: Specializing in Algerian domestic tourism, we provide hotel reservations, vehicle rentals, and all your transfers. We also offer organized stays in Tunisia and Turkey, thermal treatments in Hammam Debagh (Guelma), and visa processing for China and other destinations.
